message.text: Reading frontend.go to identify how the compiled React frontend is served in production and locate the wiring.

Go embed.FS embeds the compiled dist/* directory at build time.

Echo middleware.StaticWithConfig serves the embedded static files. spaFallbackMiddleware serves index.html for SPA routes. This wiring occurs in server/server.go at line 72.

The compiled React frontend is served by Go embedding the `dist/` directory, then serving it through Echo static middleware with an SPA fallback to `index.html`.

The wiring is in `server/server.go`.

q27.

go:embed + Echo static middleware with SPA fallback; server/server.go

In production, the compiled React app is baked into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served from that embedded filesystem. `FrontendService.Serve` in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` registers Echo `middleware.StaticWithConfig` for assets and `spaFallbackMiddleware` to return `index.html` on 404 for client-side routes.

That wiring happens in `server/server.go`:

```71:72:server/server.go
	// Serve frontend static files.
	frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)
```

The embed and middleware setup live in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`:

```20:21:server/router/frontend/frontend.go
//go:embed dist/*
var embeddedFiles embed.FS
```

```53:59:server/router/frontend/frontend.go
	// Route to serve the frontend static assets.
	e.Use(middleware.StaticWithConfig(middleware.StaticConfig{
		Filesystem: frontendFS,
		Skipper:    skipper,
	}))

	e.Use(spaFallbackMiddleware(frontendFS))
```
